Skills lab

Better questions. Smaller changes. Real evidence.

Practice replacing plausible-but-wrong output with reliable engineering workflows, using 12 reusable agent skills in .github/skills. Skills guide the agent. Tests and human review verify the result.

Start in five steps

You need Node.js 22.20+ and VS Code with GitHub Copilot Chat in agent mode, allowed by your organization. The guide, the exercises, and npm test need no npm install.

Get the starter code, checks, hints, and reference solutions from the GitHub repository, or download and extract the ZIP. GitHub Pages hosts the demos; real exercises run locally.

git clone https://github.com/AkashAi7/anti-ai-slop.git
cd anti-ai-slop/skills

Already cloned? Open the skills folder in your existing copy. ZIP downloads extract to anti-ai-slop-main; open its skills folder instead.

  1. In VS Code, use File > Open Folder and open the downloaded skills folder, not its parent. Review workspace trust before you enable agent tools. Run the following commands in that folder's integrated terminal.
  2. Start the interactive terminal guide.
    npm.cmd run demo
  3. Choose 01-clarify, then run setup, baseline, and prompt.
  4. Paste the prompt into a fresh Copilot chat and attach only the task and learner files. Answer the agent's questions yourself. The guide does not simulate or automate Copilot.
  5. Check your work.
    npm.cmd run check -- 01-clarify

On shells other than PowerShell, use npm in place of npm.cmd. A skill is not a deterministic safety boundary and does not guarantee correct output.

The 12 skills

Type the skill name after / in a fresh chat. Most skills can also be picked automatically from their description, but automatic selection varies, so test it on its own.

BeforeSkillEvidence after
The agent assumes what you meant/grill-me Explicit invocation onlyAgreed decisions and explicitly unresolved choices
The task grows without boundaries/scope-contractObservable acceptance criteria and non-goals
Confident unsupported claims/evidence-firstClaim/source ledger with uncertainty
Invented or unnecessary packages/dependency-reality-checkJustified dependency decision
Green but useless tests/test-driven-developmentMeaningful red/green regression
Speculative patch loops/systematic-debuggingReproduction, cause, and regression evidence
Framework for a tiny change/simplify-firstSmaller design preserving behavior
Unfamiliar, inconsistent patterns/repo-conventionsChanges grounded in local examples
Errors disguised as empty success/failure-pathsExplicit, tested failure behavior
Automatic agreement with reviews/review-feedbackEvidence-backed acceptance or rejection
"Done" without checking/verification-before-completionCurrent commands and observed results
Verbose, unsupported handoffs/concise-handoffShort, accurate outcome and limitations

To reuse a skill, review its whole folder and copy it to .github/skills/<name> in your own project. Keep the license notices. Reuse and composition
